hooks.name: Block high-risk shell commands
hooks.description: Blocks high-risk shell commands (terraform apply/destroy, recursive deletion of important directories) to prevent irreversible infrastructure or codebase damage.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$input | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { $cmd = $_.toolInput.command; if ($cmd -match '(?i)(terraform\s+apply|terraform\s+destroy|rm\s+-rf\s+/|Remove-Item.*-Recurse.*-Force.*(\/|\\\\)(src|docs|terraform|app|backend)(\b|\/|\\\\))') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine(\"BLOCKED: High-risk command detected: '$cmd'. This could cause irreversible damage. Get explicit user confirmation.\"); exit 2 } else { exit 0 } }"
